rows.grounds: tatpuruṣa compound referring to the body mentioned in the prior verse
absolutive indicating prior action of reaching or contacting
instruments of attack subject to transformation
resulting harmless state of the weapons

items.question: What transformation occurs to weapons upon contacting the protected body?
premises: Upon reaching it, weapons undergo a change of state.
The resulting state of the weapons is that of flowers.
items.inference: Contact with the protected body renders weapons harmless by transforming them into flowers.
items.plain_english: Upon reaching that body, weapons become flowers.
